summary: Kenny_Current_Perfumery_Inventory_Master_Aug2026_v5.xlsx is the current authority for inventory identity, stock strength, carrier, availability, product basis, preparation, and physical-compounding status. HIGH_HEDONIC_PRIORITY_METHOD_v1 is advisory only and cannot establish liking, formula, stock, or release authority. PROTOCOL.md governs target-first evidence-faithful non-compressed reconstruction. Meaningful_Complexity_Audit_v2 governs meaningful-function, interaction, ablation, perturbation, anti-collapse, and HOLD gates. The Literature Verification Ledger and Interaction/Layering Atlas are scientific or advisory sources whose hypotheses must remain distinct from direct evidence. Every formula workflow must preserve a TARGET / IDEAL FORMULA separately from the CURRENT-INVENTORY BUILD. Ambrettolide 10% in DPG is PLANNED ACQUISITION / DESIGN-AVAILABLE for computational architecture but PROCUREMENT PENDING for physical compounding until the bottle and ExactStockRef exist. Unresolved same-scope conflicts remain HOLD. This packet is locally schema- and hash-verifiable context; it is not proof that any chat read or accepted it.
